reproduction.scope: Reviewed current bounded function plus real botocore StreamingBody around synthetic in-memory bytes; no network or archived source execution

before_tests.scope: Current native helper and synthetic storage/real botocore StreamingBody only; no archived code execution

improvements: S3 research bodies are consumed through EOF, allowing botocore to enforce declared ContentLength before data is parsed, retained or published.
Short reads are joined as complete bytes. Empty bodies remain empty; explicit zeros/nulls/false values are unchanged. Oversize and non-byte streams fail without returning a partial value.
Streams close after success, oversize, read failures and SDK integrity failures. Existing request failure handling preserves the preceding public object and does not renew its clock.
Ten actual transport regressions cover complete/fragmented reads, declared-length mismatch, exact bounds, invalid stream values, immutable readback, capture and publication preservation.

limitations: Exact native and static deployment acceptance remain pending.

This preserves full transport bytes; it does not qualify upstream economics, historical vintages, forecasts or allocation authority.
